_comment: The shared POST-TUTORIAL fixture. Represents the state a player reaches after the real cold-start arc (meet Relc -> spar -> sleep Warrior L1 -> gift spear): classes {warrior:1}, met_relc/sparred_with_relc/given_spear_by_relc banked, both weapons carried (rusty_sword equipped, relcs_spare_spear in the pack), standing at the floodplains inn-door entry (7,6). Deep-loop combat scripts LOAD this instead of walking the ~40-step prologue every run. NOTE: apply() sets game.rng.state = int(rng_state) at load, OVERRIDING the CLI --seed for all post-load draws -- so the FIRST fight after a load draws rng.randi() from this fixed state and is deterministic per fixture, not per --seed (same contract as near_evolution). Position is floodplains (7,6); the proximity ambush only fires on move_player, so loading here is safe -- scripts that need to reach the street WALK the road and fight the (deterministic) ambush once. Issue #45 rng_state re-derivation: the prior value was a hand-typed raw RandomNumberGenerator.state ('9') -- the repo-wide landmine (WISave restores .state directly, not .seed, so any hand-typed small int collapses the first randi() draw to the same degenerate output; the #38 method). Re-derived by seeding a fresh RNG with .seed=1, capturing the resulting .state (-1966449618399012673), installing it here, and re-running this fixture's canonical end-to-end -- passed on the first candidate, every fight in the run unaffected in outcome.
